changelog: Scoring Rules: Soften the NUM+UNIT treatment (traceable to en_us_66). Instead of moving numeral↔unit splits into a low band, reduce the generic numeral boost so such splits rank in a mid-high preference band (still considered but not topmost). This lowers over-trust on split numeric expressions while preserving useful numeral signal.

Scoring Rules: Removed previously added targeted downgrades (proper-name-substring and left-lexical+subordinator) that were not supported by the measured critique to avoid over-broad removal of safe high-scoring cuts; changes are limited and traceable to the en_us_66 case.

Decision Procedure: Restrict explicit targeted-downgrade application to the NUM+UNIT exception and retain the existing deterministic tie-break (earlier marker wins) to avoid reintroducing a rejected tie-break variant. Tie handling remains deterministic and unchanged.
